descFull: Pure-Rust LLM inference engine for GGUF (Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Hy4, Flint). Runs models bigger than your VRAM on CUDA and Vulkan, with MTP drafts and an OpenAI/Anthropic server. 12 GB RTX 3060 vs llama.cpp: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B UD-Q5_K_M 80.5 vs 64.4 tok/s, Flint UD-Q5_K_XL 64.6 vs 48.6. With MTP: 108 tok/s (UD-Q3_K_M), up to 160 (UD-Q2_K_XL).
